content.stem: (audio) When will they start their meeting?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Is the meeting room free at three this afternoon?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Let me check the calendar. No, it’s booked until four.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Then we’ll have to start at four thirty.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I’ll update the schedule and inform the team.

content.rationale: They decide to start at four thirty.
